scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:hosted:compiled
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build:core && npm run build:standalone:compiled
scripts.build:standalone:generator: npm run build:core && npm run build:standalone:generator:compiled
scripts.build:standalone:proof: npm run build:core && npm run build:standalone:proof:compiled
scripts.build:standalone:proof:compiled: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode standalone-proof && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('standalone-proof/proof.html','safeseed-proof.html');console.log('updated safeseed-proof.html')"
scripts.build:standalone:embed: npm run build:core && npm run build:standalone:embed:compiled
scripts.build:standalone:embed:compiled: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode standalone-embed && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('standalone-embed/safeseed-proof.js','safeseed-proof.js');console.log('updated safeseed-proof.js')"
scripts.build:standalone:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:standalone:compiled && npm run build:standalone:generator:compiled && npm run build:standalone:proof:compiled && npm run build:standalone:embed:compiled && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('standalone/index.html','safeseed-demo.html');fs.copyFileSync('standalone-generator/generator.html','safeseed-generator.html');console.log('updated committed single-files: safeseed-demo.html, safeseed-generator.html, safeseed-proof.html, safeseed-proof.js')"
